supplemental_items.interpretation: Scope captures three timestamp caches in order local datetime, epoch, display epoch; clears each before optional reaction.clear_market_indexes call. Setup precedes try/yield; after yield finally clears optional indexes first then all timestamp caches in same order. If setup fails no yield/finally; if index cleanup raises, subsequent cache loop not reached. Both live entry points delegate common runner; RAW uses row preparer and singleton tuple (rows,), bucket path uses second/main buckets then live_views and bucket_delta, preserving optional None values. Union annotations are type expressions, not trading arithmetic.
